tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bde mchog snyan brgyud ras chung lugs kyi thun mong phyi dkyil brgyad las yum bka' bsdus pa lhan cig skyes ma'i sgrub dkyil dbang chog dang bcas pa pad+ma rā ga'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (396)༄༅// gu ru badz+ra wā rā hī na mā mi/ rgyal kun skyed mdzad gsang chen kun 'byung gnas// 'khor lo kun gyi 'dren pa mo de dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// gang gi smin grol lam zab 'dir dgod bya// gnas dben par yar mar gyi tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus bzang por gnas khang rgyan dang bkod pas mdzes shing rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu khebs ldan steng*/ dkyil 'khor gsum las 'og gi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yin kyang rdo rwa me ris bskor ba'i chos 'byung nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i mtha' dur khrod kyis bskor ba bri/ bsdu na tshom bus kyang rung ngo*// bar bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor ni/ de'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsi sbyar ba blugs la dar dmar bkab po// de'i steng sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor ni/ maṇ+ḍal lam me long la bdud rtsis cung zad brlan phar bya sra te/ seng ras kyis sin+dhū ra khod snyoms par btsags la dkyil 'khor 'og dang mthun par bris shing bkod par bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas phyogs su rnam bum// g.yon phyogs su las bum/ gnyis ka dar dmar gyi mgul chings dang dri bzang gi chus bkang*/ rnam bum la so lnga'i rdzas btab/ khar dung chos dang gzungs rdor bzhag /las bum la nyer lnga'i rdzas dang kha rgyan bkod/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu (397 )rnams ci bder bzhag /lcang lo/ byugs rdzas/ gos rgyan/ phyag mtshan nams phyogs bsdus kyi tsa kli'ang bkod/ dkyil 'khor mdun nas brtsams/ mchod yon dang*/ nyer spyod rnams g.yon bskor du bsham/ mdun tu nang mchod ka pā lar bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i chang dang*/

rgyab ngos su 'bul gtor bza' bca' bzad dgus brgyan pa bsham/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams dang*/ sngon gtor sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams 'du bya'o// nyams len dngos la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la/ thun mong yid bzhin nor bu las sa bcad brgyad du gsungs pa 'ga' zhig gong du tshad grub/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba dang srung 'khor bsgom pa/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ gnas khang dang mchod pa byin rlabs skyabs sems dang rdor sems sgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dbang bzhi blang ba yan chad yab bka'i sgrub thabs ltar bya ba las der bde mchog bsgom pa'i tshab tu/ rang nyid phag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pa nyid do// zhes bsgyur gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag bskyed/ bum bskyed/ mdun bskyed dbang bskur dang bcas pa'o// dang po bdag bskyed la sa bcad brgyad du gsungs pa'i dang po rten srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ dbang bzhi pa'i mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas/ nam (398)mkha'i khams su e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyi dkar la nang dmar ba kha sbyor gyi nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og gzhi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i ra ba dang dra ba/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas khyab pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba grub par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la yan lag bzhi'i dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ de'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/

ram̐ las nyi sa 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam shes yi ge bam̐ dmar po las 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ bka' brgyud bla ma la sogs te 'phags pa rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ ngan song gsum sogs sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gcer bu sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i g.yas gri gug thur du bzung nas gdug pa can la bsdigs shing*/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba/ dmar la 'khyug cing mdzes la yangs pa'i spyan gsum zur gyis gzigs shing*/ khro la 'dzum pa'i zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes shing*/ 'khor lo dang me tog gi phreng bas mdzes pa/ lhag ma thur du grol bas rked pa non cing*/ zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po'i snying ga dang g.yon cung zad bskums pas dus mtshan (399)dmar mo'i nu dbrag mnan pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i sku la mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho dar la babs shing bha ga dang nu ma rab tu rgyas pa/ bde ba chen pos rnam par myos pa'i cha byad can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku yi 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'gengs nus pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs su chud cing skye 'gro kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i bdag nyid ma/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur par bsams la/ 'khor bskyed pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od zer sku dang phyag mtshan yig 'bru thig le'i rnam par dpag tu med pa khyams dang dur khrod du 'phros/

'khor gyi lhar gyur pa ni/ khyams kyi steng 'og bar snang rnams su 'ja' 'od sprin gyi gur khang ngos la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa bkod legs du ma thogs nas mchod pa la brtson pa'i lha yi bu dang bu mos gang ba/ dur khrod rnams su phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu la sogs te gzugs brnyan dang cha lugs sna tshogs 'chang zhing ston pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpag tu med pas gang ba'o// gnyis pa go cha bgo zhing sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i yan lag la go bgo ba ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i lte bar/ oṃ bam̐ phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hrīṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo// dpral bar hrīṃ hrīṃ skyod byed ma ser mo// spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las gtum mo dud ka ste/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba/ gcer bu dpa' mo'i rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// sku gsung (400) thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams bsam/ gsum pa snod bcud sbyar zhing ye shes pa gzhug pa'i yan lag gsum gyi dang po snod bcud sbyang ba ni/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phog pas gzhal yas khang du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas pho thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ mo thams cad rdo rje phag mor gyur par bsam mo// ye shes pa gzhug pa la gsum gyi dang po/ spyan drang ba ni/ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ bdag dang lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ o rgyan la sogs te rang bzhin gyi dag pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho nas bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/

oṃ bha ga wā ti badz+ra bha ra hī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ oṃ bha ga wā ti badz+ra bha ra hī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ gsum pa gzhug pa dngos ni/ oṃ bha ga wā ti badz+ra bha ra hī sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas ye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim pas dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ gsum pa lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ de'i rkyen gyis spyi bor bka' brgyud bla ma/ snying gar 'khor lo sdom pa/ yan lag tshigs bzhi la mkha' 'gro chos skyong*/ ba spu'i bu gar rdo rje spun grogs te/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal zhing rdzogs pa grub pa nyid du gyur par bsam mo// bzhi pa dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas btab pa'i yan lag la gsum gyi dang po dbang lha spyan drangs shing ba dan 'bul ba ni/ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ slar yang bdag dang lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang rnam snang dbyer med pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ pad+ma kā ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ gyis gdan 'bul/ gnyis pa mchod bstod gsol ba gdab pa ni/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wa ra ār+ghaṃ (401 )nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pas bdag cag rnams la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gsum pa dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan pa dngos ni/ rigs lnga'i 'khor rnams kyis glu dang rol mo 'dod yon sna tshogs kyi mchod pa'i sgo nas lha'i bum pa bdud rtsi dang bcas pas dbang bskur/

sku gang*/ dri ma dag /bdud rtsi'i rgyun yar lud pa spyi bor 'khyil ba rnam par snang mdzad du gyur nas dbu brgyan pa la/ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis bdag la 'dod yon kun gyis mchod cing bstod par gyur/ mchod yon me tog bdug spos snang gsal dang*// dri chab zhal zas rol mo sna tshogs dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro 'jam mnyen reg bya rnams// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ bha ga wā te badz+ra bha ra hī sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she āḥhūm̐/ bzhi pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ lnga pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi rlung sems dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' bam̐ gyi mthar thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa las grub pa'i yig 'bru/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nye snying ste sngags kyis bskor bar bsam zhing*/ ci nus su bzla'o// drug pa slar yang mchod cing bstod pa las mchod pa ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la bsang sbyang*/ byin brlab/ rgyas par tshigs bcad dkyil chog nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ bsdu na sngags (402 )mchod tsam dang bstod pa sh+lo ka gcig bya/ brgyad pa bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ snod bcud thams cad sbyangs nas dur khrod la sogs pa'i lha rnams la thim/ de gtso mo la thim/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ de gyen rdzogs nā da'i dbyings su thim par gyur/ ces mnyam par bzhag / slar yang skad cig gis rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal bar gyur/ zhes thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang*/ gnyis pa bum pa bsgrub pa ni/

bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a a las zla ba'i gdan gnyis kyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i bum pa gnyis lto ba yangs shing mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel zhing mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi dar gyi na bza' gsol zhing*/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud bzang pos yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ yi ge bam̐ dmar po de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ las thams cad kyi bum pa'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ bam̐ las ro'i gdan gyi steng du/ lha mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba/ khro la 'dzum pa'i zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs shing*/ mdzes la yangs pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes pa/ nor bu dang me tog gi phreng bas mdzes shing lhag ma thur du grol bas rked pa non pa/ thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing*/ (403)gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ gzugs dang lang tsho dar la babs shing bha ga dang nu ma rab tu rgyas pa/ bde ba chen pos rnam par myos pa'i cha byad can gyi zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// zhes dang go cha bgo ba ni/ rdo rje phag mo dang lha mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ma yi lte bar oṃ bam̐ phag mo dmar mo sogs go cha bgo /sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas dam ye bsre/

dbang bskur nas/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ las bum gyi lha mo la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ mchod bstod kyang gong ltar bya/ las bum lha la/ dpal ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod cing gzungs thag gi sne nas lag g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung ste/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes rnam bum la brgya rtsa re las mi nyung ba dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci rigs par bzla/ bzlas dmigs bdag bskyed thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bum lha'i thugs rgyud bskul bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ mthar sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma 'bul/ mchod pa kha gsos la byin rlabs mdor bsdus bya/ nus na tshigs bcad dang mi lcogs na 'dod yon lnga sngags tsam gyis mchod/ gong ltar bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer bum nang du 'phros pas bum nang gi lha ye shes pa phye ste rang gi snying gar dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar

gyur par bsam/ gsum pa mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang*/ bdag 'jug dbang bskur bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su e e las sogs/ gang bdag bskyed ltar la/ (404 )spyan 'dren tshigs bcad/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan 'bul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ khrus gsol/ mchod rdzas dam pa 'di dag dang*// 'jig rten khams kyi mchod rdzas kun// thams cad blo yis blangs nas ni// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ gu ru bha ga wā te badz+ra bha ra hī sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod rjes/ oṃ gu ru nas/ wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes dam ye dbyer med du bsam/ dbang bskur nas rgyas gdab kyi bar dang*/ mchod pa'ang de ltar la/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sogs sh+lo ka gcig gis bstod/

bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bzlas dmigs bdag bskyed ltar la/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nye snying ste ci nus su bzla'o// mchod pa kha gsos la/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyang*/ sgrub thabs ltar byin brlab/ mchod pa dngos la bzhi las/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ gtsang bde bsil sogs yan lag (405)brgyad ldan chab// yid kyi gdung sel kun dga'i dpal ster ba'i// lha yi mchod yon dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ gu ru bha ga wā ti badz+ra bha ra hī sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ pū dza me ghas mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i 'dab phreng las// sa phyogs bsung zhim ngad pas bsil sbyin mkhan// mig gi bdud rtsir bzhad pa'i me tog 'di// bla ma= sngags thog mtha' gong ltar la/ puṣ+pe pū dza= rang byung dri ngad sbyar ba'i spos kyi sprin// nam mkha'i pha mthar gtibs las zhing khams kun// rab tu zhim pos kun dgar byed pa 'di// bla ma= dhū pe= nyi zla nor bu'i zer phreng 'bru mar mes// ma lus mun pa'i dpal 'phrog snang ba yis// nyin mtshan mi phyed kun tu gsal ba 'di// bla ma= ā lo ke= dri med chab la tsan+dan ga bur dang*// gur gum la sogs rnam par sbyar ba'i rdzas// bsil bde nyon mongs tshad nad drung 'byin dri// bla ma= gan+dhe= kha dog dri dang ro brgyar ldan pa'i bshos// ji tsam myong yang mi mthun med pa yi// lha yi zhal zas bda' rgu ji snyed pa// bla ma= nai wi d+ya= rnga sil dung dang rgyud mang cha lang sogs// yan lag 'bum sde'i sgra dbyangs snyan sgrog pa// rol mo'i khyad par ma lus ji snyed kun// bla ma= shab+da= zhes dang*/ 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/ rab 'byams zhing gi dkyil 'khor thams cad par// rgyal ba'i spyan la mdzes pa ma lus kun// gcig bsdus gzugs kyi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// badz+ra rū pa pū dza=

rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i snyan la 'jebs pa ma lus kun//gcig bsdus sgra yi rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dpyid// bla ma= shab+da= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i shangs la zhim pa= gcig bsdus dri yi rdo rje'i= bla ma= gan+dhe= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i (406)ljags la bda' ba= gcig bsdus ro yi rdo rje'i= bla ma= ra sa= rab 'byams= rgyal ba'i sku la bde ba= gcig bsdus reg bya rdo rje'i= bla ma= spar+she= phyi snod nang bcud 'bul ba rnams kyang spro na yab bka' star bya/ gnyis pa nang mchod bdud rtsi 'bul ba'ang de lta rung*/ gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra bī ṇe āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje pi waṃ ma sngon mos pi waṃ gi sgras mchod/ oṃ badz+ra waṃ she āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje gling bu ma ser mos gling bu'i sgras mchod/ oṃ badz+ra mṛ daṃ ge= rdo rje rnga zlum ma dmar mos rnga zlum gyi sgras mchod/ oṃ badz+ra mu ra dze= rdo rje rdza rnga ma ljang gus rdza rnga'i sgras mchod/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ye= rdo rje bzhad ma dmar mos bzhad pa'i 'dzum mdangs kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye/ rdo rje sgeg ma sngon mos mdzes pa'i 'gying bag sna tshogs kyis= oṃ badz+ra gī tī= rdo rje glu ma ljang gus snyan pa'i glu dbyangs= oṃ badz+ra nṛ t+ye= rdo rje gar ma ser mos mdzes pa'i gar= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe= rdo rje me tog ma dkar mos me tog= oṃ badz+ra dhū pe= rdo rje bdug spos ma sngon mos bdug spos= oṃ badz+ra dī paṃ= rdo rje snang gsal ma dmar mos snang gsal= oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe= rdo rje dri chab ma ljang gus dri chab= oṃ badz+ra dar+she= rdo rje gzugs ma dkar mos spyan la mdzes pa'i gzugs= oṃ badz+ra ra sa= rdo rje ro ma dmar mos ljags la bda' ba'i zhal zas= oṃ badz+ra spar+she= rdo rje reg ma ser mos sku la bde ba'i na bza'= oṃ badz+ra dharme= rdo rje chos dbyings ma sngon mos chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mchod cing mnyes par rol par

bsam/ bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod gnas dam pa mchod mkhan 'khor gsum po// dbyer med chos nyid ngang du ro gcig pa'i// bla med blo 'das mchod pa dam pa 'di// bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// dge bas 'gro kun de nyid rtogs par shog / bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan rnam kun (407 )sogs rkang brgyad dang*/ spro na/ oṃ/ srid zhi'i dge legs ma lus stsol mdzad pa'i// bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa rnams dang ni// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo 'khor bcas la// bdag ni sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ āḥ pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan steng na// bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo dmar mo ni// rab mdzes yid 'ong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// gri thod 'dzin zhing kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten// dbu skra sil bu gyen brdzes 'khor lo dang*// me tog phreng mdzes thod skam cod pan sogs// lhag ma thur grol rtse mo li zhing 'khyil// rus rgyan dril g.yer khrag 'dzag do shal 'phyang*// spyan gsum khro 'dzum nyams rgyas mdzes chags kyi// lhan skyes bde bas myos pa'i rnam 'gyur can// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'jigs dus snying ga brdzis// dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus skyed pa'i yum// rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ khyams kyi steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun// yid 'ong mchod sprin du mas mchod byed pa'i// lha mo bcu drug rgyud sde bzhi la sogs// bar khyams gang ba'i 'khor la= /dur khrod nang bzhugs phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu// rnal 'byor pho mo 'dre srin yi dwags dang*// sha za smyo byed 'byung po ro langs sogs// mtha' yas phyi 'khor rnams la= bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo 'khor bcas la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa ma lus bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bzhin du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol// dge ba bla med byang chub chen por bsngo// bsngos bzhin myur 'grub gyur cig phaṭa swā hā/

gnyis pa la gnyis/ bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ spro zhing nus na 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang gi cho gas rdzogs par blang*/ mi lcogs na bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs ltar ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bzhi blangs pas chog par gsungs so// (408 )gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po la gzhung gi sdom tshig las bcu gnyis su gsungs pa'i dang por khrus bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams sgo drung du 'du/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod cing las bum chus khrus bya/ gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i sprul pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dang*/ thugs ka'i mtshon cha'i char gyis bgegs thams cad rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad par bsams la/ thun gyis brab cing*/ sum+bha ni'i sngags brjod cing bskrad/ gsum pa chos bshad rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ lo rgyus rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ 'dir skabs su bab ma gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams kyi mthar thug ma rgyud yang snying 'khor lo sdom pa'i zab chos snyan brgyud nor bu skor gsum zhes 'phags yul gyi grub thob gzhan la ma grags pa'i zab chos thun mong ma yin pa grub pa'i dbang phyug tai lo pa nas chig brgyud rim par byon te/ de mtshungs mi la bzhad pa rdo rje la ye shes mkha' 'gros lung bstan ltar zhal slob thun mong ma yin pa la snyan brgyud kyi dum bu re gnang ba'i nang tshan/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa nas snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i yid bzhin nor bu skor gsum la/ rnam grangs mang du bzhugs pa las 'dir yum bka'i phyi dkyil brgyad kyi nang tshan/ bsdus pa lhan cig skyes ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bgyi ba la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la thog mar 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul/

bzhi pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ thal mo me tog bcas/ rje btsun ma dang dbyer med pa'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa'i// mgon po chen por bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs (409)rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ lan gsum/ lnga pa chos bshad pa la thun mong gi chos ni// sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi 'bab cing*// gting mtha' med pa'i srid mtsho 'dir// skyo ba'i sems ni rab bskyed la// rnyed dka'i rten mchog gru gzings 'dir// stong nyid snying rje'i skya bar rdzas// brtson 'grus drag pos drangs byas te// bla med thar pa'i gling mchog tu// don gnyis nor bu thob par gyis/ zhes dang*/ khyad par gyi chos ni/ bskal par bsags pa'i mun pa yang*// nyi zla sgron me la sogs pa'i// 'od kyi snang bas skad cig mas// sel ba ji bzhin thog med nas// bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa// ye shes snang ba skad cig mas// sel babs rdo rje theg pa yi// gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba// bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi// dbang bskur zab mo sbyin bya yi// khyed rnams dga' dang spro bar gyis/ zhes bshad/ drug pa sdom pa bzung ba la// thun mong gi sdom pa ni/ bla ma yi dam gtsor bzhugs pa'i// sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// che ge mo zhes bgyi pa bdag /bla med byang chub ma thob bar// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs spyi ltar lan gsum/ khyad par sngags kyi sdom pa bzung ba ni/ bla ma yi dam gtsor bzhugs pa'i// sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol//

che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub ma thob bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// (410)tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag cu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nas bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ lan gsum/ bdun pa mtshams sbyor spyi ltar gyis me tog byin la/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ sngags de nyid kyis gdong g.yogs dmar po bcing*/ brgyad pa nga rgyal 'phos la nang du gzhug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso mo'i sprul pa rje btsun ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma zhig srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du byon pas/

rang gi lag nas khrid de rdzu 'phrul gyis skad cig la srung 'khor gyi nang du tshud par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes nang du zhugs par bsam/ dgu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar bsam zhing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// yid bzhin nor bu (411)gtsug gi rgyan// tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs kyi mchog /dpal ldan sku la skyabs su mchi// de bzhin du lho sgo nas/ 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun gcod cing*// chos kyi 'khor lo skor mdzad pa// bde mchog 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /dpal ldan sku la= nub nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun ma// ma gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dpal ldan bla mar phyag 'tshal lo// byang nas/ dpa' bo dpa' mo rdo rje yi// spyan can chos skyong rdo rje spun// ma lus lus pa med pa la// phyag 'tshal gus pas skyabs su mchi/ zhes thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar bas btud do// bcu pa me tog dor ba ni/ thal mo kha sbyar ba'i me tog rang rigs kyi lha la phul bar bsams la/

oṃ puṣ+pe mā la pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes dor ba'i me tog lhag pa'i lhas rang gi spyi bor bcings shing lha de las mar me gnyis mched kyi tshul du spyi bor thim par bsam/ oṃ puṣ+pe mā la sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes me tog spyi bor bkod// bcu gcig pa mig dbye ba ni/ ma rig pa'i ling thog mig dang dang lhan cig tu bsal bar bsams la phyag rgya dang bcas/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// phye bas ye shes mthong bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥprāṃ zhes mig dbye/ bcu gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mthong ba bstan pa ni/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha// de la dad pa rab tu bskyed// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags brjod pas// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med (412)par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams gyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// de phyir khyed rnams skal ldan 'gyur// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rigs skye// dam tshig mchog la gnas par gyis/ ngas khyed rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal nas dkyil 'khor bzang po lta bar yod pas ltos shig /'di na dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ des mtshon te mdun gyi 'og ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyis sprul sku/ bar bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyis longs sku/ steng sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyis chos sku mtshon la/

mtshon bya chos kyi sku nyid mtshon byed gzugs kyi rnam par shar ba rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan cig skyes ma'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de'ang nam mkha'i dbyings su chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs bskyed sngags bor ba'i mngon rtogs ltar ngo sprad pa las/ dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ khyams kyi steng 'og bar snang sogs nas/ dpag tu med pas gang bar gyur/ bar brjod mthar/ dngos grub kyi 'byung gnas bla ma yin pas nga la ltos/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa yin pas dkyil 'khor la ltos/ zhes steng 'og bar gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gsum po mngon rtogs ltar bstan la sku gsum du ngo sprad/ phrin las sgrub pa'i mkha' 'gro dam rdzas dang*/ bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong gtor ma'i rnam par bzhugs pa dang*/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i rdo rje spun rnams dngos su bzhugs pa la ltos la dga' bar gyis shig / ces brjod/ gnyis pa zhugs nas dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ dbang dngos dang mtha' rten gnyis/ dang po la'ang bzhi yod pa las/ thog mar snang ba lhar ngo sprad pa bum dbang gi sdom la brgyad du gsungs pa'i dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la bum dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa sgo gsum bam̐ du (413 )bsgyur ba ni/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis bdag gi sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs shing 'od du zhu nas bla ma'i zhal du drangs pas mkha' nang du bam̐ du gyur/ bam̐ thugs ka nas spros pad nyi ro yi gdan gyi steng du bzhag par gyur/ bam̐ zhes brjod/ gsum pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ bam̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gcer bu sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i g.yas gri gug thur du bzung nas gdug pa can la bsdigs shing*/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mo na yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba dmar la 'khyug cing mdzes la yangs pa'i spyan gsum zur gyis gzigs shing*/

khro la 'dzum pa'i zhal mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra sil bu'i stod cha gyen du brdzes shing*/ 'khor lo dang me tog gi phreng bas mdzes pa/ lhag ma thur du grol bas rked pa non cing*/ zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po'i snying ga dang g.yon cung zad bskums pas dus mtshan dmar po'i nu dbrag mnan pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i sku la mi mgo skam po lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis mdzes pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho dar la babs shing bha ga dang nu ma rab tu rgyas pa bde ba chen pos rnam par myos pa'i cha byad can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku yi 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'gengs nus pa/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs su chud cing skye 'gro kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i bdag nyid ma/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur par bsam mo/ / bzhi pa go bgo ba ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ phag mo dmar mo// snying gar haṃ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo// mgrin par hriṃ mo rmongs byed (414)ma dkar mo// dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ skyod ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las gtum mo dud ka ste/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa'i gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'chang ba/ gcer bu dpa' mo'i rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// lnga pa ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis bdag la dpal rnal 'byor ma dbab par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i bam̐ dang*/

rang lus yi dam du gsal ba'i stong ra'i nang*/ rtsa dbu ma pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad dang khams dmar po nyi ma/ dkar po zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang 'dra'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rnal 'byor ma tshon gang tsam gsal la yangs pa mgar ba'i sol mal nas thon pa'i lcags bsregs lta bu las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rang 'dra'i sku dang phyag mtshan yig 'bru me'i rang bzhin 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i rnam par spyan drangs pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gtso mo las kyang rang 'dra dpag tu med pa 'phros/ tsheg sgra 'ur sgra dang bcas snying ga'i rnal 'byor ma rang lus la thim pas/ rnal 'byor ma mer 'bar ba dang drag tu 'bar zhing rang lus kyang mer 'bar bas mi bzod pa'i bde ba rgyas par gyur par bsams la rig pa hur phyungs la rol mo drag tu 'khrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra bha ra hī dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes dbab/ oṃ badz+ra bha ra hī su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes spyi bor rgya gram du bzhag pas brtan par bsam/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lha tshogs rnams (415)kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar bsam ste/ rnam rgyal bum pa lag tu thogs la/ rnal 'byor ma dpal 'khor bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs las byung ba yi// sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyong byed pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur zhing bum chu sbyin/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang ste spyi bor 'khyil ba rnam par snang mdzad du gyur nas dbur brgyan par gyur/ des mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gi go bcad nas rin 'byung cod pan gyi dbang ni/

dkyil 'khor gtso mo'i thugs ka nas rin 'byung gi rang bzhin dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gyi rnam par 'phros te mgo bor bcings par bsam/ oṃ rat+na mu kuṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes spyi bor bcing*/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin dbang rdzas rdo rje'i rnam par 'phros te lag tu gtad par bsam/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje gsor/ don grub dril bu'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso mo'i thugs ka nas/ don grub kyi rang bzhin dbang rdzas dril bu'i rnam par 'phros te/ lag tu gtad par bsam/ oṃ ma hā ghāṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dril bu dkrol/ rnam snang ming gi dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso mo'i phyag g.yas spyi bor bzhag cing g.yon mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ rdor dril spyi bor bsnol bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra bha ra hī/ gsang mtshan nam/ a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ gsang mtshan 'di zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// brtul zhugs rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ e ṣa dha ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga byin pas snying gar rdor sems gsal bar gyur par bsam/ de rnams kyi dbang don gcig char du ngo sprad pa ni/ de ltar dbang thob (416)pas nyon mongs pa lnga/ ye shes lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ yum lnga/ phung po lnga/ rgyal ba rigs lngar ye nas grub pa la yid ches par gyis shig / ces brjod/ bdun pa mnga' dbul ba ni/ lcang lo byugs rdzas bgo rgyan phyag mtshan rnams gcig car du byin par bsam/ tsakli rnams phyogs gcig tu thogs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ skal ldan khyed rnams lcang lo thor tshugs 'chang*// byugs rdzas byug cing rgyan rnams 'dogs pa dang*// phyag mtshan 'dzin cing mchod bstod phun tshogs pas// yi dam rdo rje phag mor mnga' gsol lo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra bha ra hī sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod cing mnga' gsol bar bya'o// de ltar bum pa'i dbang thob pas// sbyang gzhi lus lha la sbyang bya dman par 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs shing*/ sbyong byed bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sbyangs 'bras mchog gi sprul sku thob par 'gyur ro// brgyad pa sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ slob ma'i spyi bor thim/ sku las kyang sku dpag tu med pa 'phros lus la thim pas/ skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sku bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus rje btsun ma'i skur gyur/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur/ yang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ slob ma'i mgrin par thim/ zhal nas kyang ā li kā li la sogs te sngags kyi phreng ba dpag tu med pa (417)'phros/ lce la thim pas/ skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad dag par byas/ gsung gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag rje btsun ma'i gsung du gyur/ lam gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur/ yang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ slob ma'i snying gar thim/ yang rdo rje dril bu gri gug thod pa ḍa ma ru kha ṭ+wām̐ ga la sogs te phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa 'phros/

snying gar thim pas/ skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid rje btsun ma'i thugs su gyur/ lam pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur/ yang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi/ spyi mgrin thugs ka'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gcig char du 'phros/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim/ skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du sgo gsum gcig char du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgo gsum rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs su gyur// lam blo 'das phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur par bsam/ yum bka' rgyas pa'i skabs dbang gong ma gsum so sor bskur bar snang yang*/ bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir de kas 'thus par gsungs so// (418) gnyis pa mtha' rten la/ rgyas par sdom chog la bdun du gsung kyang*/ 'dir bsdus pa'i dbang du byas te gsum las/ dang po rjes gnang dang lung bstan ni/ rdor dril spyi bor bsnol la/ dkyil 'khor 'dir na dbang thob pas// deng nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi// las dang bya ba mtha' dag la// dbang zhing ma 'ongs pa yi dus// gsang mtshan 'di zhes bya ba yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// gnyis pa dbugs dbyung dang gzengs bstod ni/ zab mo'i dbang ni thob tsam gyis// mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal zhing*// byang chub chen po'i lam zhugs pas// khyod rnams dga' dang spyo bar gyis/ gsum pa bdud rtsi bsten pa ni/ bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi ka pā la'i bdud rtsi rje btsun ma 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi dam rdzas su gyur/

par bsam mo// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod do bstod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du= chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du= rdo rje mched lcam rnams kyi zhal du= yul 'di'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag= 'gro ba rigs drug sems can= rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= rgyal ba mched pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skong gyur cig /rigs drug 'dod pas tshims gyur cig /lan chags bu lon khyer gyur cig /sems can thams cad rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che (419)dus myur du thob pa'i skal pa mchog dang ldan pa nyid du gyur cig /

ces pas mchod rjes bdud rtsi'i ka pā la lag pa g.yon du bzung nas g.yas pas bkab ste/ rnal 'byor ma dpal bdud rtsi'i gzugs// bdud rtsi rnal 'byor ma rang yin// thabs shes dbyer med bdud rtsi 'di// gang bsten grol lo pu rnams kye/ zhes dang*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad kyang*// gnyis med bdud rtsi bsten pas grol// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyang*// gnyis med bdud rtsi bsten pas grol// ma dang mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*// gnyis med bdud rtsi=chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral yang*// gnyis med=rdo rje'i mched lcam thams cad kyang*// gnyis med=de phyir skal ldan khyed rnams kun// rdo rje phag mo zhu ba yi// gnyis med bdud rtsi 'di bsten pas// grol bar 'gyur ro bu rnams kye// zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi bsten nas myang*/ 'bral med smon lam gdab pa ni/ lhag pa'i bsam sbyor dag pa'i ngang nas/ deng nas byang chub ma thob bar// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma rdo rje spun// tshogs zhing dam pa rnams dang ni// nam yang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /dam chos mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig dang*// nam yang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog /bdag sogs sems can thams cad ni// de ltar gyur pa'i mthu nus kyis// brgyud pa'i rnam thar 'khyongs pa dang*// rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun// bdag gis smin cing grol bar shog / ces smon lam gdab bo// des dbang bskur grub nas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyis dam tshig khas blang*/ lus longs spyod dbul ba'i mos pas/ bdag gi sgo gsum longs spyod bcas// deng nas 'dren pa khyed la 'bul// nyes ltung dri mas gos gyur na// cha yis spyad cing skyob tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal phul/ dge bsngo (420) brjod la grol lo// gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ sdom tshig las/ gtor bsngo tshogs bshags lhag gtor btang*// bzod gsol nyer bsdu bsngo shis bya// zhes rnam grangs bcur gsungs pa'i dang po gtor bsngos dang*/

gnyis pa tshogs bshags lhag gtor btang ba rnams yab bka' ltar bya/ lnga pa gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ byin brlab/ rgyas par na/ rab 'byams zhing gi sogs tshigs bcad sngags bcas kyis mchod/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan rnam kun sogs rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ drug pa dbang bzhi len pa ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sogs gong gi skabs su 'byung ba ltar brjod/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ldan du gyur/ bdun pa bzod gsol ni yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang*// cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa dang*// bdag gis bgyis nongs ci mchis pa// de yang= bag med brjod pa ma dag pa// rgyud nas gsungs pa'i cho ga bzhin// ma lcogs 'khrul pa ci mchis pa// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol// brgyad pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ 'og ting 'dzin sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu ba longs sku'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ longs sku'i dkyil 'khor 'od du zhu ste chos sku'i dkyil 'khor la thim// chos sku'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ steng sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs nas dpral bar thig le bya/ gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams brtan bzhugs bya/ dgu pa bsngo ba dang bcu pa bkra shis rnams kyang yab bka'i gsham nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i 'dren pa mo// rgyal ba kun skyed rdo rje (421 )rnal 'byor ma'i// zab gsang grub pa'i snyan nas snyan brgyud 'dir// 'jug par nus rnams sngon sbyangs skal ldan nges// mkha' spyod rdo rje btsun mo'i grong khyer du// lhan skyes mdzes ma mchog gis mdun bsus nas// bde stong 'gyur ba med pa'i thig ler bsdams// mkha' khyab 'gro kun phyam gcig sgrol nus shog

/ces ras chung snyan brgyud lugs kyi yab bka'i smin byed dang 'brel bar nye bar mkho bas mtshams sbyar te/ rtsa ba'i yig cha gtsang smyon he ru ka yab sras kyi gzhung dang brgyud pa snga ma rnams kyi gsung las snying por bsdus te karma bka' brgyud kyi gral mthar 'khod pa karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod de bī ko ṭī'i dga' tshal du rang lo gya bdun par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa blo gsal gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// / (422)
